aggressive_definition_excerpt: A total of 4,404 prostate cancer cases including 1,278 nonlocalized or high-grade cases were recorded during the average follow-up period of 8 years.
cohort_total_n_excerpt: The analyses included 82,483 men who completed a detailed quantitative food frequency questionnaire in 1993-1996.
reason: The prospective cohort analyzed both total incident prostate cancer and the aggressive composite of nonlocalized or high-grade cancer.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: Among men with the highest intake of legumes, the risk reduction was 11% for total prostate cancer (RR = 0.89, 95% CI = 0.80-0.99, p for trend = 0.007) and 26% for nonlocalized or high-grade cancer (RR = 0.74, 95% CI = 0.61-0.90, p for trend = 0.007) compared to men with the lowest intake. Similar risk reductions were observed for soy products and for legumes excluding soy products in separate analyses.
estimate_classifications.reason: The supplied soy estimate is the total prostate cancer estimate; the abstract establishes that soy products were analyzed, while its numeric estimate comes from the supplied full-text evidence.
